关于我 / About

主要研究视觉语言模型（VLM），聚焦跨模态图像理解与多模态对齐相关工作，探索提升模型在医学影像场景下的感知与推理能力。

My research focuses on Vision-Language Models (VLM). I work on cross-modal image understanding and multimodal alignment, aiming to improve the perception and reasoning capability of models for medical imaging.
